user.title: Govee Native — Android account
user.description: Provide the Govee Home email/password to use the private Android app API. Developer API key is optional for full capability controls. An email code may be required.

verify.title: Verify Govee Home account
verify.description: Enter the verification code Govee emailed to your account. Codes expire after roughly 15 minutes.

error.invalid_input: Enter email and password together, or provide a Developer API key
error.cannot_send_code: Could not send the Govee verification email

abort.already_configured: This Govee account is already configured

data.app_mqtt: Use private AWS IoT MQTT (Govee app account)
data.use_legacy_api_key: Use existing legacy Govee Developer API key for scenes and fallback (opt-in; may increase API traffic)
data.prefer_bluetooth: Prefer Bluetooth after LAN, before cloud MQTT
data.configure_bluetooth: Set a Bluetooth address for an H6199

bluetooth.title: H6199 Bluetooth address
bluetooth.description: Select your backlight and enter its six-byte Bluetooth MAC address, shown in the Govee app device information or Home Assistant Bluetooth discovery. Use this when automatic account metadata does not provide it.

error.invalid_bluetooth_address: Select an H6199 and enter a six-byte MAC address separated by colons.

abort.no_bluetooth_devices: No H6199 backlight was discovered in this account.
